topic: Equipment setup, tools and spares for Gas welding and Brazing procedure
syllabus_extract: Equipment setup, tools and spares for Gas welding and Brazing procedure
specific_objectives: 31.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to explain arc welding and brazing procedure

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of Gas welding and Brazing equipment setup; Safety precautions regarding gas cylinders and torches; Instructor supervision of tool identification and spares verification
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between welding and brazing?
List three essential safety precautions for handling gas cylinders.
Identify the two main types of gas welding torches used in aviation maintenance.

development.content:
Gas welding equipment components
Acetylene and oxygen cylinder handling
Regulator and hose assembly setup
Torch tip selection and adjustment
Flame characteristics and control

topics: Brazing torch operation and heat control
Preparation of joint surfaces for brazing
Application of flux and filler rod
development.content:
Brazing equipment and filler metals
Brazing torch operation and heat control
Preparation of joint surfaces for brazing
Application of flux and filler rod
Cooling and post-brazing inspection

topics: Maintenance of welding and brazing tools
Storage and inventory of spare parts
development.content:
Maintenance of welding and brazing tools
Storage and inventory of spare parts
Troubleshooting common equipment faults
Record keeping for tool usage
Final safety check before shutdown

summary_questions: Explain the correct sequence for connecting gas cylinders to the welding torch.
Describe the role of flux in the brazing process and why it is necessary.
Identify two common causes of equipment failure during gas welding operations.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report detailing the specific tools and spares required for a standard aircraft gas welding repair, referencing the next lesson plan on actual welding procedures.
